text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaand, we've reached the halfway mark!
The
Umamusume in the center of the
pack are
watching the front runners
closely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the top with Nakayama Festa
will
require more than raw power and
stamina—we'll
also need quick thinking
and adaptability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How much has she grown since her junior
year,
and how much more can she grow
from here on
out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can't afford a single mistake in the
race.
However, on the third turn...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa lets her guard down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (What happened?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (My legs aren't hurting or anything...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (But I feel cold.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the following day, I take her for
a check
up with the academy's doctor.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Apparently, nothing's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Right. If I had an injury, it would be
goodbye to
the Classics.
choice_data_list: ケガがなくてよかった
choice_data_list_en: I'm glad nobody was hurt.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what's your diagnosis?
Looking at
yesterday's race, will we be
going to the Arc this
year?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That response just told me everything I
needed to
know. You're about to say I'm
not ready, right?
choice_data_list: 正直に言ってもいいか？
正直に言ってもいい？
choice_data_list_en: Can I be honest with you?
Can I be honest with you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true. She still has room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When getting ready for a scheduled
competition,
athletes will manage their
intensive training
period and body
conditioning to suit the timing
of the
competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, overseas competitions
need even
finer adjustments due to the
traveling required.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All we can do is race-focused training.
We'll even
need to align our days of rest
with the race's
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She should continue honing her skills by
racing
more against other Umamusume
here in Japan.
For example...
choice_data_list: 君の上限を設定するにはまだ早すぎる
貴方の上限を設定するにはまだ早すぎる
choice_data_list_en: It's far too early to set a limit on your potential.
It's far too early to set a ceiling on your potential.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown? Hm?
choice_data_list: クラシック三冠を成長の機会にしてみたり
choice_data_list_en: Or maybe use the Classic Triple Crown as an opportunity to grow...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby,
and the
Kikuka Sho are races you only
get one shot at.
And you want me to
treat them like training
grounds?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. "Just the right amount," you say.
choice_data_list: 君には、ほどよい緊張にもなると思う
貴方には、ほどよい緊張にもなると思う
choice_data_list_en: I think it'll provide just the right amount of tension for you.
I think it'll provide just the right amount of tension for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not your phone, it's mine. That's
weird...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm... It's my old coach...

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Festa. I'm glad you picked up. Sorry
for the
sudden call. Um...

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
You know how you always bring flowers
when you
visit my daughter in the
hospital? Well... Um...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Coach? I don't like how you're sounding.
What's
going on?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text: Ah... right, sorry. Well, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
Is it... possible for you to swing by the
hospital
today?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Teach?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When we arrive in the hospital room,
Nakayama
Festa's mentor greets her with
a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her arms, visible beneath the sleeves of
the
hospital robes, are noticeably
thinner than when
we met last fall.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming, Festa. You too,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You granted my selfish request even
though it
was so sudden.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hang on, Teach. Why are there so many
more
tubes than usual?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Listen, Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I only have... I have a year left.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I already knew I didn't have long.
choice_data_list: どういうことですか？
choice_data_list_en: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
My latest examination just clarified how
much
time is left. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
If I think of it that way, it'll help me to
make good
use of what I have.
choice_data_list: タイムリミットって……
choice_data_list_en: A time limit...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Rather than fight the inevitable, I'd
rather burn
every last ember afforded to
me, so that when it's
all over, I'll have no
regrets.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, today could be my last
day, or
even tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't say stuff like that. You need to be
strong
like you always are!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Festa... I know my own body's limitations
better
than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
My life may not have been long, but
being your
teacher and getting to guide
you was my greatest
pride.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
So, I don't want you to come see me
again. You
have to keep moving forward
without looking
back.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I don't want you to see me becoming a
shadow of
the mentor you once knew.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: B-but!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But! We made a promise!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We promised I'd show you how I conquer
the
world someday, that I'd show you
where my life
would take me...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yes. I truly wanted to see that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No. Don't say that...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tell me you want to see it...

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Festa. Sorry for suddenly
forcing this
on you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Coach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Is Teach really beyond help? Does she
really have
to give up like this?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
She's been fighting against the disease
for a long
time.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
She might just be feeling a little tired.
She
probably just wants to rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's no way that's true! Even if there's
only a
one-percent chance, Teach
would—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You, stay out of this.
choice_data_list: ……ナカヤマ、待って
choice_data_list_en: ...Nakayama, wait.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: ちゃんと相手の目を見て、話そう
choice_data_list_en: Look them in the eye when you speak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The father of Nakayama Festa's mentor
looks at
us with red, saddened eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
He must have been crying many times
over. After
all, this is the last thing any
loving father would
want for his
daughter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how long her mentor had been
thinking
of this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer...
choice_data_list: （もしかして、今までの言動も……）
choice_data_list_en: (Could everything she's said and done until now also be...?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Please... help Festa live her life to the
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.
choice_data_list: （――ナカヤマフェスタを、生かす）
choice_data_list_en: ï¼ââBring out the best in Nakayama Festa.ï¼

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I were to enter the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe
now, do you think I'd have a
chance of winning?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Teach once told me there was something
magical
about Paris, like in the musicals.
choice_data_list_en: ...Right now?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think? If I were to race
now,
could I win?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I knew it...
choice_data_list: それは……
choice_data_list_en: That's...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I told her I was going this year, it
wouldn't give
her even a fragment of
hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah. Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Frickin' hell...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't know what to do.
With all of
this happening so suddenly,
my mind's gone
blank.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what to tell her. I don't
know how to
answer. Except...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: ……なあ、ナカヤマ
……ねえ、ナカヤマ
choice_data_list_en: ...Hey, Nakayama.
...Hey, Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: やりたい賭けがあるなら、ちゃんと教えて
やりたい賭けがあるなら、ちゃんと教えて
choice_data_list_en: If there's a bet you want to make, tell me properly.
If there's a bet you want to make, tell me properly.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: 君の賭けなら、俺は最後まで付き添うよ
貴方の賭けなら、私は最後まで付き添うよ
choice_data_list_en: If it's your gamble, I'll see it through with you to the end.
If it's your gamble, I'll see it through with you to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even now, the feeling I got when we first
became
a team hasn't wavered in the
least.
choice_data_list: それが君を生かすなら
それが貴方を生かすなら
choice_data_list_en: If that brings out the best in you...
If that brings out the best in you...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Live my life... to the fullest...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, hope is what gives us the
strength to live.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Geez. You do realize what you're saying
to me,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You'd better be prepared... you damn
do-gooder.
